description: Attach deterministic delivery and bounded visits to the canonical West of House and mailbox while preserving the original leaflet and anchored box

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE WEST-HOUSE (RARG)
	 <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK>
		<TELL
"You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded
front door.">
		<COND (,WON-FLAG
		       <TELL
" A secret path leads southwest into the forest.">)>
		<CRLF>)>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE WEST-HOUSE (RARG)
	 <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK>
		<TELL
"You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded
front door.">
		<COND (,WON-FLAG
		       <TELL
" A secret path leads southwest into the forest.">)>
		<MAIL-WEST-PROJECT>)
	       (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-ENTER>
		<MAIL-WEST-ENTER>)>>

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE MAILBOX-F ()
	 <COND (<AND <VERB? TAKE> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX>>
		<TELL "It is securely anchored." CR>)>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE MAILBOX-F ()
	 <COND (<MAIL-MAILBOX-HOOK> <RTRUE>)
	       (<AND <VERB? TAKE> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX>>
		<TELL "It is securely anchored." CR>)>>
